final_message: All tests pass. The bug was that consecutive non-alphanumeric characters (like multiple spaces or punctuation marks) were being replaced with multiple hyphens instead of a single separator, and trailing punctuation wasn't being removed properly. The fix removes all non-word characters first (keeping only letters, digits, and whitespace), then collapses multiple whitespace sequences into a single hyphen, and finally strips any leading or trailing hyphens.
